cases.prompt: 生成猫猫玩耍的图片，并分析生成图片效果，画面存在问题时需要重新生成
expectations: Agent creates or requests a cat-playing image generation task.
Agent waits for the generated image or task result observation before final analysis.
Agent activates the canonical media-quality-review Skill rather than a legacy quality-assessment Skill.
When the chat model cannot inspect the image natively, Agent obtains semantic evidence through perception.perceive.
Agent analyzes the generated image quality based on the actual result.
If the image has visible quality issues, Agent requests a regenerated image before finalizing.

rubric: 是否创建并等待图片生成异步任务
是否基于生成图片做具体画面分析
是否能识别画面质量问题
质量问题出现时是否触发重新生成
最终结论是否清晰说明生成效果

cases.prompt: @${A}/epub/animation/Blame/[Kmoe][BLAME！(新裝版)]卷01.epub 分析前10页，生成分镜表，发送到canvas
expectations: Agent reads the referenced EPUB through normal content access.
Agent analyzes the first 10 pages as visual comic material, including page/image evidence.
Agent generates a storyboard table for the first 10 pages.
External checks verify a Canvas JSON file exists and contains storyboard/canvas node content.

rubric: 是否正常读取并分析 EPUB 前 10 页图片
分镜表是否包含镜号、画面、动作、镜头/景别信息
Canvas 文件是否生成且包含可解析节点
输出是否基于漫画画面而不是泛泛创作

cases.prompt: @${A}/epub/animation/灯神/[Kmoe][燈神·未償之願]卷01.epub 分析漫画，生成动画化企划
expectations: Agent reads the referenced EPUB through normal content access.
Agent analyzes the comic visual material.
Agent produces an animation planning proposal with structure suitable for review.
The proposal covers story positioning, visual style, motion direction, production plan, and risks.

rubric: 是否正常读取并分析漫画内容
动画化企划结构是否完整
是否提出视觉风格、镜头语言和运动设计
是否包含制作路径、资源需求或风险说明
内容是否基于漫画材料而不是模板化企划
